correctness.rationale: The proof derives the square-perimeter normal form from the primitive Euclidean parametrization, converts exact prime support into a unique coprime prime-power allocation, proves the signed fractional-part criterion, and obtains the counting constant from Weyl equidistribution plus an explicit polytope volume. Exact bounded verification found zero mismatches.

originality.rationale: Yiu and OEIS provide the square-perimeter parametrization and sequences but not the exact fixed-prime-support bijection, infinitude for every finite prescribed odd-prime support, or the explicit asymptotic. Exact and synonymous searches did not locate stronger coverage. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from older differently worded problem literature.

value.rationale: The theorem classifies every fixed finite prime support, proves all such supports occur infinitely often, and gives a universal support-size combinatorial factor in the asymptotic count; the one-prime slice reduces to an irrational-rotation criterion of density one half.
